core_conflicts: Seeking shelter from the cold rain, Juliana arrives at her new husband's modest woodland cottage and discovers an unexpected sense of peace beside the hearth.
When Gerald and his spiteful companion arrive at the woodland cottage to mock Juliana's fallen status, her stoic new husband returns from the forest to silently send them fleeing.

As Juliana inspects her late mother's weathered herbal grimoire, Alexander bonds with her over rustic medicinal knowledge and war-worn memories, gently altering her perception of what true wealth means.

When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.

When Alexander returns to the cottage gravely wounded and soaked in blood, Juliana tends to his injuries, leading to an intimate confrontation where their unspoken feelings and scarred pasts finally collide.
